thread:
olivia: FYI deploybot blocked the release for service-telemetry. Promote failed: tag `staging-20260325` points to unexpected digest after ECR lifecycle GC kicked in.

deploy-bot: Promote aborted: tag mismatch. Expected digest sha256:aa11bb22..., registry reports sha256:cc33dd44.... Policy requires tag->digest match for release tags. Audit: promote-1795009999.

ci-bot: Build finished and pushed. CI push log shows put-image succeeded and cosign attestation attached. Push timestamp 2026-03-25T13:05:12Z.

theo: sounds like lifecycle policy garbage-collected an untagged manifest we depended on and ECR recycled the tag to a later mirror job. Did we disable daily mirror pruning?

registry-team: We had a recent lifecycle tweak to prune untagged manifests older than 7 days. There was a race: the nightly mirror recreated the tag for a stale testing digest at 02:10 PT, then GC removed the older manifest, and ECR reassigned the tag to the testing digest when our push included digest-only upload without tag update due to immutability. Ugly.

olivia: ok options: 1) request registry to restore deleted manifest from backup (slow) 2) retag the verified digest as a new tag (staging-20260325+rev1) and push attestation 3) manual digest pin override for promote 4) abort release window.

release-manager: minimal customer impact preferred. retag + attestation is safest for provenance. If replication lags we'll consider digest pin for canary only. Let's do retag + cosign and record operator. Change window 16:00-16:20 PT.

theo: i'll fetch the manifest and put-image. sequence: 
```
aws ecr batch-get-image --repository-name service-telemetry --image-ids imageDigest=sha256:aa11bb22... --region us-west-2 --output json > manifest.json
aws ecr put-image --repository-name service-telemetry --image-manifest file://manifest.json --image-tag staging-20260325+rev1 --region us-west-2
cosign sign --key ksm://projects/redwood/registry/service-telemetry staging-20260325+rev1
```

registry-team: Note: if manifest was fully removed we may not be able to fetch it. Check `batch-get-image` exit code. If missing, we need backup restore.

theo: batch-get-image succeeded. Retag done: staging-20260325+rev1 -> sha256:aa11bb22... Attestation pushed.

deploy-bot: Promote verification: checking attestation presence in all regions... eu-west-1 attestation missing, will recheck in 60s.

olivia: registry-team, can you trigger mirror attestation push to eu-west-1 (manual copy) so promote isn't blocked?

registry-team: On it. copying attestation from us-west-2 to eu-west-1 now. response: 200 OK.

deploy-bot: Attestation verified across target regions. Starting promote of staging-20260325+rev1 -> canary 5% us-west-2. Audit: user=theo, reason="retag after lifecycle GC induced tag drift".

ci-bot: smoke tests green on canary pods.

release-manager: Added release note: "service-telemetry: retagged to staging-20260325+rev1 after registry lifecycle pruning caused tag drift; no code changes. CI to include unique build suffix to prevent tag reuse. Follow-up ticket created: infra#1322."

olivia: created infra ticket to tighten lifecycle/retag interplay and to add alert when promote sees tag mismatch: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/issues/1322

theo: also queued a CI change: append `-b${BUILD_ID}` to release tags to avoid collisions. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ci/pull/589

deploy-bot: Promote complete: canary healthy. Override/audit recorded.

release-manager: closing thread. keep monitoring replication metrics for 24h. reopen if regressions. :white_check_mark:
